```python
import selfies as sf
from rdkit import Chem
parts='[C][C][Branch1][C][C][O][C][=Branch1][C][=O][Cl].[C][C@@H1][Branch1][C][O][C][=N][C][=C][N][=C][C][=C][S][C][Ring1][Branch1][=C][Ring1][=Branch2][N][Ring1][N][C@H1][C][C][C@H1][Branch1][Ring1][C][N][O][C][Ring1][Branch2].[C][C][N][Branch1][Ring1][C][C][C][C].[C][C][=C][C][=C][C][=C][Ring1][=Branch1].[Cl][C][Cl]'.split('.')
for x in parts:
 sm=sf.decoder(x); m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(sm)
 print('\nSELFIES:',x,'\nSMILES:',sm,'\nCanonical:',Chem.MolToSmiles(m) if m else None)
 if m:
  print('formula atoms',Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m) if hasattr(Chem,'rdMolDescriptors') else '')
  for a in m.GetAtoms():
   if a.GetSymbol() in ('N','O','S','Cl'):
    print(a.GetIdx(),a.GetSymbol(),'degree',a.GetDegree(),'H',a.GetTotalNumHs(),'arom',a.GetIsAromatic())
```
